content: Dtype downcasting (float64->float32, int64->int32/int16, object->category) is the lowest-effort highest-impact pandas memory optimization, often cutting memory 50-80%. Specify dtype in read_parquet/read_csv upfront rather than downcasting after load. chunksize/iterator-based reads process files larger than RAM in pieces; combine with usecols to avoid loading unneeded columns. Always spot-check downcasted values for precision loss before trusting them.
